bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage=deploy/state/notice-pr81-ce50d5e1
test -s "$stage/gaybbs.mjs"
test -s "$stage/live-before.mjs"
echo '84823483e18e89e00572c59a19038c2aff623171b8fe187c2675d92548e5c407  '"$stage/gaybbs.mjs" | sha256sum -c -
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(sha256sum "$stage/live-before.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
old_image="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)" = "$old_image"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
export stage old_image
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,re,hashlib,json,os,collections
p=pathlib.Path(os.environ["stage"]);old=(p/"live-before.mjs").read_bytes();new=(p/"gaybbs.mjs").read_bytes()
allow={"src/"+n for n in "bot/noticeInteractions.ts bot/postingHandlers.ts db/migrate.ts gaybbsBot.ts services/announcementApplications.ts services/announcementNotifications.ts services/noticeEditor.ts services/publicPostRepository.ts services/publishService.ts services/telegramDispatcher.ts".split()}
def parts(b):
    m=list(re.finditer(rb"^// src/[^\r\n]+$",b,re.M));counts=collections.Counter();keys=[]
    if len(m)<10:raise SystemExit("NOTICE_CHAPTER_MARKERS_MISSING")
    for x in m:
        n=x.group()[3:].decode();counts[n]+=1;keys.append((n,counts[n]))
    return b[:m[0].start()],keys,{k:b[x.start():(m[i+1].start() if i+1<len(m) else len(b))] for i,(k,x) in enumerate(zip(keys,m))}
a,ak,am=parts(old);b,bk,bm=parts(new)
changed=sorted(k for k in set(am)|set(bm) if am.get(k)!=bm.get(k))
outside=sorted(k for k in changed if k[0] not in allow)
sameorder=[k for k in ak if k[0] not in allow]==[k for k in bk if k[0] not in allow]
scope=not outside and a==b and sameorder
obj={"source_sha":"ce50d5e1b755b374b7527d895e2fd7246f565cfc","old_image":os.environ["old_image"],"old_sha":hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest(),"new_sha":hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest(),"changed_chapters":changed,"outside_notice":outside,"prefix_equal":a==b,"non_notice_order_equal":sameorder,"scope_verified":scope,"old_sections":len(ak),"new_sections":len(bk)}
(p/"checkpoint.json").write_text(json.dumps(obj,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(obj))
PY
printf '%s\n' 'FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local' 'USER root' 'COPY --chown=node:node --chmod=600 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs' 'USER node' > "$stage/Dockerfile"
docker build --network none --pull=false -q -f "$stage/Dockerfile" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:notice-offline-ce50d5e1 "$stage"
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:notice-offline-ce50d5e1 --check /app/gaybbs.mjs
test "$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:notice-offline-ce50d5e1 /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 84823483e18e89e00572c59a19038c2aff623171b8fe187c2675d92548e5c407
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$old_image"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
echo NOTICE_OFFLINE_IMAGE_STAGED=PASS
docker image inspect -f 'NOTICE_CANDIDATE_IMAGE={{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:notice-offline-ce50d5e1
python3 -c 'import json;assert json.load(open("deploy/state/notice-pr81-ce50d5e1/checkpoint.json"))["scope_verified"],"NOTICE_SCOPE_REVIEW_REQUIRED"'
echo NOTICE_SCOPE_VERIFIED=PASS
